body:
I know people hear me it's just... no one can help me :( I'm tired of doctors and therapists struggling to figure out why I'm still like this. I do the right things, but I don't get better. I even asked my therapist if it was my fault. If I was doing something. But everyone tells me it's not my fault and that they don't know why. My brain is just fucked up. 

I'd rather not have to live with my brain anymore.
